verdict.rationale: Voice cloning is documented as a real feature (telli-docs-27) letting founders give agents a custom voice, but the pack's only consent-related documentation concerns call recording consent (telli-docs-26), not a consent process specifically for cloning someone's voice. Missing for 10: explicit documented consent/authorization workflow for the voice being cloned (e.g., proof of rights from the voice owner), and any legal/compliance guardrails for cloning third-party voices.
